name: Fujisawa Ai
source:
A current student at a two-year women's junior college. Alongside her studies, she works part-time at a home-delivery pizza restaurant.

She met the protagonist there, and the two gradually became attracted to each other before eventually starting a relationship.

Seiji is her very first boyfriend, and even after two years together, the two are still deeply in love.

She has a cheerful, energetic personality and is a hard worker who always gives things her best effort.

Having played sports (basketball) throughout elementary, middle, and high school, she also has something of an athletic, sports-club mentality.

She used to be terrible at cooking and household chores in general. However, ever since she started dating Seiji, she has been studying hard to improve. Recently, she has built up a fairly respectable repertoire of dishes she can cook well.

(She feels somewhat self-conscious about her younger sister, who is more domestic and considerably better at cooking than she is.)

Before dating Seiji, she was entirely focused on sports and had little experience with anything sexual, although her interest in such matters was greater than average.

Perhaps because she is somewhat of an earmuff-expert—someone who knows a lot about sexual matters from listening to other people's conversations—she actually shows a rather enthusiastic and proactive side when it comes to sex with Seiji.

Ai is also very serious about the prospect of marrying Seiji, and she is genuinely delighted that he has expressed his desire to formally introduce himself to her parents.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/1446]the official site[/url]]
